metrics.name: purchase_order_header_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.business_documents WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'PurOrderHeader'

metrics.name: purchase_order_line_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.business_document_lines WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'PurOrderDetail'

metrics.name: purchase_order_total
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM public.business_documents WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'PurOrderHeader'

metrics.name: purchase_order_line_quantity
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM public.business_document_lines WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND legacy_source_table = 'PurOrderDetail'
